title: Si Bien: Granting a Point Formally
goal: Grant a true point in formal speech and writing with si bien + the indicative, and compare it with aunque, a pesar de que, pese a and no obstante.

items: I can grant a true point formally with si bien and the indicative.
I can choose between si bien, aunque and a pesar de que by register.
I can use the new words for reports and proposals.
